command_line:
set -eu
cat > run_deseq2.R <<'RSCRIPT'
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
input <- args[1]
outfile <- args[2]
summaryfile <- args[3]
counts_df <- read.csv(input, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
if (!"geneID" %in% colnames(counts_df)) stop("Expected a geneID column")
gene_ids <- counts_df[["geneID"]]
count_cols <- setdiff(colnames(counts_df), "geneID")
count_mat <- as.matrix(counts_df[, count_cols, drop=FALSE])
mode(count_mat) <- "integer"
rownames(count_mat) <- gene_ids
condition <- ifelse(grepl("^KL", colnames(count_mat)), "KL", ifelse(grepl("^WL", colnames(count_mat)), "WL", NA))
if (any(is.na(condition))) stop("Could not infer KL/WL condition from all sample names")
coldata <- data.frame(condition=factor(condition, levels=c("KL", "WL")), row.names=colnames(count_mat))
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=count_mat, colData=coldata, design=~ condition)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast=c("condition", "WL", "KL"))
coef_name <- grep("condition.*WL.*KL", resultsNames(dds), value=TRUE)
if (length(coef_name) != 1) stop(paste("Unexpected resultsNames:", paste(resultsNames(dds), collapse=",")))
shr <- lfcShrink(dds, coef=coef_name, res=res, type="normal")
out <- as.data.frame(shr)
out$geneID <- rownames(out)
out <- out[, c("geneID", setdiff(colnames(out), "geneID"))]
write.table(out, outfile, sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)
keep <- !is.na(out$pvalue) & !is.na(out$log2FoldChange) & out$pvalue < 0.05 & abs(out$log2FoldChange) > 1 & out$baseMean > 10
cat("DESeq2_version\t", as.character(packageVersion("DESeq2")), "\n", sep="", file=summaryfile)
cat("contrast\tWL_vs_KL\n", file=summaryfile, append=TRUE)
cat("shrinkage\tnormal\n", file=summaryfile, append=TRUE)
cat("total_genes\t", nrow(out), "\n", sep="", file=summaryfile, append=TRUE)
cat("foreground_genes\t", sum(keep), "\n", sep="", file=summaryfile, append=TRUE)
